args.lesson: What worked: reusing saved independent baseline checks and actual CLI executions resolved the narrow hash-description question without restarting review. What failed: assuming a prior manifest must exist created an irrelevant assertion failure. Next time distinguish absent optional evidence from a product defect and close the supported review promptly. Synthetic checks establish behavior only, not customer delivery or revenue.

description: Read the consolidated independent evidence: six baseline checks and six actual CLI checks passed; the missing-manifest assertion was inapplicable. This supports closing the finite review and handing the unchanged correction to acquisition for host-gated release. Feedback remains uncertain: zero classified and five unclassified sources do not establish zero demand. No funding or revenue is verified.
